case when NOT_HIV_FLAG is not null then 'Not HIV' when OOJ_CASE_FLAG is not null then 'OOJ Case' when OOJ_PROVIDER_FLAG is not null then 'OOJ Provider' when PT_ON_PREP_FLAG is not null then 'PREP' when NON_PROMPT_FLAG is not null then 'Non Prompt' when DECEASED is not null then 'Deceased' when FEDERAL_FACILITY is not null then 'Federal Facility' when NDVL_AT_DX is not null then 'NDVL at time of dx' when PERINATAL is not null then 'Perinatal' when PKP_FLAG is not null then 'PKP' else null end RIA_INELIGIBLE_REASON
, ${PARAMETER_NAME}_NOTES NOTES , (select LISTAGG(follow_up_desc, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY RIA_DOC_ID) from RIA_FOLLOW_UP followup, CODED_RIA_FOLLOW_UP_CODES coded where ria_doc_id = ria.DOCUMENT_ID and followup.follow_up_cd like '%${PARAMETER_NAME}%' and coded.FOLLOW_UP_CD =followup.follow_up_cd) FOLLOW_UP_CD
,(select LOOKUP_NAME from CODED_RIA_DOC where REF_COLUMN = 'CASE_CLOSURE_CD' and LOOKUP_CD = ria.CASE_CLOSURE_CD) CASE_CLOSURE_CD ,CALC_EHARS_HIV_DX_DT ,row_number() over (partition by ria.DOCUMENT_ID order by CALC_EHARS_HIV_DX_DT) rn
,TO_CHAR (calc_ehars_dx_dt (m.hiv_dx_dt, n.hiv_dx_dt), 'mm/dd/yyyy') AS CALC_EHARS_HIV_DX_DT , row_number() over (partition by ria.DOCUMENT_ID order by TO_CHAR (calc_ehars_dx_dt (m.hiv_dx_dt, n.hiv_dx_dt), 'mm/dd/yyyy')) rn
from nyehms_ria_doc ria JOIN document_locator doc
ON (ria.lab_doc_id = doc.document_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN ehars_person_nyc n ON (ria.curr_nyehms_stateno = n.nyehms_stateno AND n.status_flag NOT IN ('D', 'P') AND n.hiv_aids_cdc = 'Y') LEFT OUTER JOIN nyehms_ehars_stateno_map m ON (ria.curr_nyehms_stateno = m.nyehms_stateno AND m.status_flag NOT IN ('D', 'P') AND m.hiv_aids_cdc = 'Y')
where ria.MERGED_RIA_STATENO IS NULL and nvl(STATENO_DELETED, 'N') != 'Y'
and complete_Date is not null
and complete_Date is null
and NVL(DIAGNOSIS_SETTING_TYPE, 'X') = 'ONLINE_TEST'
and not exists (select 1 from NYEHMS_STD_MESSAGE_SENT sent, person_doc_association pdoc where sent.follow_up_doc_id = pdoc.document_id and pdoc.dissassociation_date is null and pdoc.stateno = ria.curr_nyehms_stateno and sent.cdess_delete_date is null )
and NVL(RIA_ELIGIBLE, 'Y') = 'Y'
and NVL(RIA_ELIGIBLE, 'Y') = 'Y' and curr_nyehms_stateno not in (select stateno from ( SELECT p.stateno, MIN (calc_collection_date) AS min_seq_collection_date FROM std_hiv_eclrs_doc s, person_doc_association p, nyehms_ria_doc nr WHERE s.document_id = p.document_id AND p.dissassociation_date IS NULL AND p.stateno = nr.curr_nyehms_stateno AND interpret_cd LIKE 'VALID%' AND test_result != 'NO RESULT' GROUP BY p.stateno) where min_seq_collection_date is not null)
and NVL(RIA_ELIGIBLE, 'Y') = 'Y' and ARV_BEGIN_DATE is null and curr_nyehms_Stateno not in (select stateno from ( SELECT stateno, arv_begin_date FROM (SELECT stateno, arv_begin_date, ROW_NUMBER () OVER ( PARTITION BY STATENO ORDER BY SUBSTR (arv_begin_date, 7, 4) || SUBSTR (REPLACE (arv_begin_date, '.', '9'), 1, 2) || SUBSTR (REPLACE (arv_begin_date, '.', '9'), 4, 2)) RWNUM FROM (SELECT p.stateno, ra.arv_begin_date FROM raw_acrf_doc rd, raw_acrf_arvs ra, person_doc_association p, nyehms_ria_doc nr WHERE ra.acrf_doc_id = p.DOCUMENT_ID AND p.dissassociation_date IS NULL AND ra.acrf_doc_id = rd.document_id AND P.stateno = nr.curr_nyehms_stateno AND ra.arv_use_type = 'HIV Tx' AND ra.ARV_BEGIN_DATE IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT pda.stateno, s.pt_arv_start_date_text AS arv_start_date FROM std_prf_doc s, person_doc_association pda, nyehms_ria_doc nr WHERE s.document_id = pda.document_id AND pda.dissassociation_date IS NULL AND PDA.stateno = nr.curr_nyehms_stateno AND LENGTH (pt_arv_start_date_text) > 3 AND (arv_treatment = 'Y' OR PT_ARV_6_MO = 'Y'))) WHERE rwnum = 1) where arv_begin_date is not null)
and RIA_ELIGIBLE = 'N'
and RIA_ELIGIBLE = 'Y'
and RIA_ELIGIBLE = 'N'
and SOUNDEX_CHECK_DATE is not null
and NVL(RIA_ELIGIBLE, 'Y') = 'Y' and exists (select 1 from RIA_FOLLOW_UP followUp, CODED_RIA_FOLLOW_UP_CODES coded_followUp where RIA_DOC_ID = ria.DOCUMENT_ID and coded_followUp.FOLLOW_UP_CD = followUp.FOLLOW_UP_CD and PROGRAM_TYPE = #{PARAMETER_NAME} and not exists (select 1 from RIA_INTERVENTION where followUp.RIA_FOLLOW_UP_ID = RIA_FOLLOW_UP_ID))
and nvl(${PARAMETER_NAME}, '0') not in ('0')
) where rn = 1

from nyehms_ria_doc ria JOIN document_locator doc
ON (ria.lab_doc_id = doc.document_id) LEFT OUTER JOIN ehars_person_nyc n ON (ria.curr_nyehms_stateno = n.nyehms_stateno AND n.status_flag NOT IN ('D', 'P') AND n.hiv_aids_cdc = 'Y') LEFT OUTER JOIN nyehms_ehars_stateno_map m ON (ria.curr_nyehms_stateno = m.nyehms_stateno AND m.status_flag NOT IN ('D', 'P') AND m.hiv_aids_cdc = 'Y')

select RIA_PROVIDER_FOLLOW_UP_ID, TO_CHAR(DATE_OF_CONTACT, 'MM/DD/YYYY') DATE_OF_CONTACT, STATENO, CONTACT_REASON, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_ROLE, FACILITY, CONTACT_PERSON, RIA_MATERIALS_PROVIDED, CREATE_DATE from RIA_PROVIDER_FOLLOW_UP_CALL where RIA_DOC_ID = #{docId} and END_DATE is null order by create_date asc

with ria as (
Select Min(Trunc(initial_collection_date)) initial_collection_date , doc.TEST_TYPE_CD as "DOC_TYPE", curr_nyehms_stateno,n.DOCUMENT_ID as "DOCUMENT_ID", LAB_DOC_ID from nyehms_ria_doc n, document_locator doc where (ria_eligible = 'Y' or ria_eligible is null) and n.lab_doc_id = doc.DOCUMENT_ID and initial_collection_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{riaFlaggedFromDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') and TO_DATE(#{riaFlaggedToDate},'MM/DD/YYYY') group by curr_nyehms_stateno, n.DOCUMENT_ID, LAB_DOC_ID,doc.TEST_TYPE_CD ), labs as ( select p.stateno, Min(trunc(calc_collection_date)) calc_collection_date from std_hiv_eclrs_doc s, person_doc_association p, ria r where s.document_id = p.document_id and p.dissassociation_date is null and p.stateno = r.curr_nyehms_stateno and calc_collection_date > r.initial_collection_date GROUP BY p.stateno ), data as ( SELECT r.DOCUMENT_ID as document_id, r.LAB_DOC_ID as lab_doc_id , r.CURR_NYEHMS_STATENO as stateno, r.DOC_TYPE as DOC_TYPE,r.initial_collection_date, calc_collection_date, ABS(calc_collection_date - initial_collection_date) diff FROM ria r, labs l WHERE r.CURR_NYEHMS_STATENO = l.stateno (+) ) select stateno, document_id, lab_doc_id, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(initial_collection_date),'MM/DD/YYYY') as initial_collection_date, DOC_TYPE, case when diff <= 7 then 'Y' else 'N' end as lab7days, case when diff <= 14 then 'Y' else 'N' end as lab14days, case when diff <= 21 then 'Y' else 'N' end as lab21days, case when diff <= 30 then 'Y' else 'N' end as lab30days, case when diff > 30 then 'Y' else 'N' end as labover30days from data
